intro: O2S keeps all its data in 1 JSON document. Each item below is 1 list in that document (top level or inside a record), with its fields, keys, links, owner and what is kept. Field names are as stored; Required yes means every row written by the current code carries it.

items.title: Where O2S keeps its data: 1 JSON document

blocks.p: O2S has no tables of its own. All O2S data is 1 JSON document. On the live server it sits in MySQL, table app_state, in 1 row (id = 1). Without a database URL the server keeps the same document in data/state.json. In this tab a "list" means a top-level array of that document, or an array inside one of its records.

head: Column
Type
Required
Default
Meaning
Written by
rows: Revision number. Goes up by 1 on every save.
The whole O2S document as JSON text.

list: Read: GET /api/state returns {rev, data}. GET /api/rev returns only rev; the page polls it and pulls the document only when rev changed.
Write: POST /api/state with header x-base-rev. If the server rev is not the base rev, the server answers 409 with its own copy and the page merges (merge3) and saves again.
The server removes the key users from every read and write (stripUsers). Logins live in the separate table auth_users (username, name, role, pass_hash).
The page never saves its session keys: currentUser, role, screen, expanded (dataOnly).
Every load runs ensureState: it fills missing lists, then runs the one-off migrations and the every-load repairs (see SC-34).

Merge rule (merge3): a list whose every row has an id is merged row by row by id. A list where any row has no id is treated as 1 value: 1 person's copy wins and the other person's new rows are lost. This is why every new list row carries an id.

blocks.note: S-09 in docs/SECURITY-REGISTER.md (15 Oct 2026): most audit rows written during a session carry no id, so 2 saves at the same moment can lose audit rows. ensureRecordIds gives them ids only at the next load.

blocks.p: Where the code does remove rows today:

list: doRemoveLot (Removed shift output): removes the lot, its shift entry and its production log row. A corrections row keeps the lot, Kg and COA state.
voidProdEntry: removes a production log row (COO only; the screen is not reachable).
Every load: dedupePackingLots, dedupeShipmentsV1 and healVU26144ProdLog remove duplicate rows.
taken: marks older than 1 day are dropped.
COA v2 send-back and reject remove doneAt and doneBy from each test.
startNewYearClean (COO, typed phrase RESET TO ZERO, after a downloaded backup) empties every transaction list, audit and actionLog and sets seq to 1000. Master data stays.
The June purges removed imported orders, shipments, batches and production rows (SC-32).
